Court Rejects Investor Bid to Investigate Philips Sleep Apnea Device Recall

An Amsterdam court has denied a request from investors to launch an investigation into Royal Philips NV's management of a 2021 recall of its sleep apnea devices. The court's decision means the investors will not be able to compel an inquiry into the company's actions surrounding the recall.
